rationale: Record a layout-semantics fix that crosses these families' selectors. CSS white-space is now inherited by native text: a Label left at the initial value normal follows its nearest ancestor that set another mode (Label::soft_wraps), so text inside a white-space: nowrap container stays on one line, and setWhiteSpace invalidates layout when a mode changes. The compat css/whiteSpace row and style-props reference record the rule. No importer lowering, DesignIR shape, capture path, renderer selection, asset format, fixture or threshold changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
